# Step 6: Image Styling

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Step 6: Image Styling

Use flexbox to center the image within the background section of the card.

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="card">
3        <div class="background">
4            <div class="image-wrapper">
5                <img src="/images/learn-css/jane-austen.jpg" alt="Jane Austen's profile picture">
6            </div>
7        </div>
8
9        <div class="content">
10            <h2>Jane Austen</h2>
11
12            <p>
13                Frontend Developer
14                <br>
15                <a href="#" class="link" title="Programiz">Programiz</a>
16            </p>
17
18            <ul class="chips">
19                <li class="chip">Figma</li>
20                <li class="chip">ReactJS</li>
21                <li class="chip">NodeJS</li>
22            </ul>
23            <div class="action-button">
24                <a href="#contact-me" title="Contact Me">Contact Me</a>
25                <a href="#portfolio" title="View Portfolio" class="secondary">View Portfolio</a>
26            </div>
27        </div>
28    </div>
29</div>
```

```css
1.background {
2    flex: 1 1 250px;
3    display: grid;
4    place-items: center;
5    background-color: #ebeffa;
6}
```

Ensure the image is responsive and fits well within the designated area.

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="card">
3        <div class="background">
4            <div class="image-wrapper">
5                <img src="/images/learn-css/jane-austen.jpg" alt="Jane Austen's profile picture">
6            </div>
7        </div>
8
9        <div class="content">
10            <h2>Jane Austen</h2>
11
12            <p>
13                Frontend Developer
14                <br>
15                <a href="#" class="link" title="Programiz">Programiz</a>
16            </p>
17
18            <ul class="chips">
19                <li class="chip">Figma</li>
20                <li class="chip">ReactJS</li>
21                <li class="chip">NodeJS</li>
22            </ul>
23            <div class="action-button">
24                <a href="#contact-me" title="Contact Me">Contact Me</a>
25                <a href="#portfolio" title="View Portfolio" class="secondary">View Portfolio</a>
26            </div>
27        </div>
28    </div>
29</div>
```

```css
1.background .image-wrapper {
2    display: flex;
3    width: 220px;
4    height: 220px;
5    border-radius: 50%;
6    overflow: hidden;
7    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
8    border: 1px solid white;
9}
10
11.background img {
12    max-width: 100%;
13    height: auto;
14    object-fit: cover;
15}
```
